strategies.name: bull_flag_ma_pullback
strategies.description: Ross Cameron bull flag: after a strong run, a light-volume pullback to the 10/20 MA, entry when volume returns and price takes out the prior candle high.

source.quote: have a light volume pullback, usually to the 10 or 20 day moving average on the 1 or 5-minute chart

decisions: 'Run higher' = a >3% gain over 20 bars at some point in the last 10 bars (book gives no number)
'10 or 20 MA' = EMA(20) touch within 0.3%; book's chart MA is a 9 EMA, so trend check uses ema_stack(9,20,50)
'Light volume pullback' = previous bar volume below 20-bar average; 'volume picks back up' = rel_volume >= 1.5
Entry trigger = close above prior bar high (first candle to make a new high off the flag)
Stop at the 5-bar low = the flag's low, which the book calls the defined risk point
Target 2R and 24-bar time stop chosen because day trades must close the same session; book gives no target
Book uses 1m/5m stock charts; mapped to 5m/15m crypto
uncodable: Not coded yet: bull_flag_pattern(pole_min_pct, flag_max_bars, flag_max_retrace)

strategies.name: flat_top_breakout
strategies.description: Breakout over a flat resistance level (in the book, premarket highs) on high relative volume; buy-stops of shorts fuel the move.

source.quote: a flat top breakout over premarket highs

decisions: 'Flat top' approximated: the last 5 bars retested the 30-bar high to within 0.3% (price pressing the same ceiling)
Premarket high replaced by the 30-bar high, since crypto has no premarket session
High volume = rel_volume >= 2, reusing the book's 2x momentum threshold (p. 34)
Stop = 5-bar low (base of the consolidation); 2R target and same-day time stop are our choices

strategies.name: momentum_relvol_breakout
strategies.description: Momentum candidate (above MAs, 2x relative volume, no nearby resistance) breaking to new highs.

source.quote: High Relative Volume of at least 2x above average.

decisions: 'Strong daily chart above the moving averages' approximated on the trading TF by close > EMA200 and stacked EMAs (no cross-timeframe feature)
'No nearby resistance' = close above the 100-bar high
Relative volume is volume / 20-bar average, not time-of-day-adjusted as the book specifies
Stop 2.5x ATR from the book's position sizing chapter (p. 37-38)

strategies.name: reversal_rubber_band_long
strategies.description: Long side of the reversal strategy: a stock at new intraday lows after 5-10 straight red candles with extreme RSI; buy the first candle that reverses, trail the stop.

source.quote: Look to buy the first candle that begins to reverse with a stop either at the high/low or minus 20 cents

decisions: 'New intraday low' = low below the previous 78 5m bars (one US session; book p. 28)
'5-10 consecutive candles of same color' approximated by a >3% drop over 6 bars; true streak needs a new feature
RSI period not given; RSI(14) < 10 used (very rare on 14; consider rsi(2)/rsi(5) in testing and record the result)
'First candle that begins to reverse' = green candle closing above the prior bar high
Stop at the 5-bar low = the reversal low (book: at the low or 20 cents below); 20 cents not portable to crypto
Book says use trailing stops; PSAR trailing chosen, 36-bar time stop to keep it intraday
RSI(14) below 20 (the book gives no period; RSI(14) under 10 almost never happens on crypto 5m bars). Five or more red candles in a row before the first green one.
uncodable: short side: short the first red candle after 5-10 green candles at new highs with RSI > 90, stop above high (p. 35-36)
bearish spinning top break entry (short example, p. 36)

strategies.name: breakout_retest_hold
strategies.description: Break of a defined resistance level on high relative volume, then a retest of the level that holds; enter on the hold.

source.quote: ideally it breaks out and comes back and tests that level and holds, that is a good entry point

decisions: Resistance level = the 40-bar high as it stood 8 bars ago, so the breakout and retest happen within the last 8 bars
'High relative volume' = rel_volume >= 1.5 during the breakout window (book gives no number)
Retest = low came within 0.5% of the level in the last 2 bars while close holds above it
Stop under the retest low (3-bar low); 2R target is our choice

strategies.name: support_bounce
strategies.description: Buy a bounce at a defined support level; exit if support breaks.

source.quote: If we buy at support then we know we are wrong if it breaks below that price and can exit the position.

decisions: Support = 50-bar low; entry when price comes within 1% of it without breaking it and closes green
Uptrend filter close > EMA200 because the book says trade with the trend and prefers higher-TF levels (p. 24, 43)
Stop just under the support (the 50-bar low), per the book's vital-level stop (p. 39-40)
Book warns many 'levels' are random; a multi-touch level detector would be more faithful

strategies.name: daily_new_high_breakout_atr_stop
strategies.description: Go long on a breakout to new highs on the daily chart with a 2.5x ATR stop and 1% account risk (NVDA example).

source.quote: we want to get long on the recent breakout to new highs.

decisions: 'New highs' = close above the prior 50-bar high (book does not give the lookback)
Stop 2.5x ATR(14) and 1% risk exactly as in the book's example
Exit by trailing close below EMA50, following the book's trend rule of closes below a moving average (p. 24) and letting winners run (p. 42)

strategies.name: trend_bb50_stop_long
strategies.description: Multi-month trend long (SPY example) with the stop at the lower Bollinger Band of 2 SD around the 50 SMA.

source.quote: with the bottom band (two standard deviations from the 50SMA) being your stop loss.

decisions: The book's entry is discretionary ('the bull market is going to continue'); approximated by a rising 50 SMA, higher highs/lows and a close back above EMA20
Stop = lower BB(50,2) as in the book; 1% risk as in the book
Exit and time stop chosen by us (multi-month horizon = up to 120 daily bars)

strategies.name: rsi_oversold_to_50ma
strategies.description: Buy when RSI moves into oversold territory and take profit when price reaches the 50-period moving average; stop at a trend line.

source.quote: you might buy when the RSI moves into oversold territory and rake profits once it reaches the 50-period moving average

decisions: 'Oversold' = RSI(14) < 30 (book gives no levels); entry when RSI crosses into it
The target is the 50-period MA, which the grammar cannot express; approximated with a 1.5R target and a requirement that price is at least 2% below the 50 SMA so there is room
The book's stop is an upward or horizontal trend line; approximated by the 20-bar low
The book's example market is gold/forex
uncodable: take profit exactly at the 50-period MA

strategies.name: trend_pullback_broad_screen
strategies.description: Book's broad FinViz trend-pullback screen: price above the 20-day SMA, within 5% of the 50-day high, down on the day.
decisions: Screen criteria taken exactly; the book uses it to build a watchlist, so entering at the close of the screened day is our simplification
Stop: book's plan says a multiple of the TF's ATR or swing low; 2.5x ATR per p. 38
2R target and 20-bar time stop are our choices
uncodable: market cap < $2B, float < 50M, price > $1, average volume > 100K/day (p. 56) - stock universe filters

strategies.name: sma5_streak_pullback
strategies.description: Book's narrow mechanical trend-pullback screen: above the 20 SMA, closed above the 5 SMA for 7+ days, closes below it today.

source.quote: Price has closed above 5-day simple moving average 7+ days in a row, but closed below it today

decisions: Rule coded exactly, with 7 explicit prior bars; on 4h it is applied to bars rather than days
Stop = recent swing low (10-bar low), one of the two stops in the book's trend-pullback plan (p. 55)
Entry at the close of the signal bar; 2R target and 20-bar time stop are our choices

strategies.name: trend_pullback_plan
strategies.description: Written trend-pullback plan: higher highs and lows with momentum, shallow light-volume pullback to a moving average/consolidation, rejoin the trend; exit on closes below the MA.

source.quote: Look for a shallow pullback into a consolidation on light volume and momentum.

decisions: Trend = higher highs/lows (trend_structure) plus stacked EMAs
'Shallow' = price still within 5% of the 20-bar high (book: avoid dramatic pullbacks); pullback touches EMA20 (p. 24 'pullbacks to... moving averages')
'Light volume' = 5-bar average volume below the 20-bar average; 'momentum' kept with RSI(14) > 45
Trigger = close above the prior bar high
Stop 2.5x ATR (book allows ATR multiple or swing low); exit on close below EMA50 to approximate 'consecutive closes below a moving average'
uncodable: exit on two consecutive closes below support/MA (only single-close trailing available)
